posts.body:
Hi, I am new on here, just joined yesterday. I am having a bit of a problem. I woke up this morning, went to the loo and had a drop of brown blood on the toilet and in my wee. I was really worried so phoned my local 'bleeding in early pregnancy' suite and went down for a check up. I am only about 2 weeks pregnant so from what I have read, baby is only 2 millimetres long (tiny weeny). I had an internal scan and the sonographer said she couldn't see anything. She asked which test I had done, it was a pack of two and they were BOTH positive and I did them on different days. The midwives told me that clearblue is the best one to do as it ONLY picks up the hcg hormone. Anyway, I had some blood taken, the midwives said it would be checked for pregnancy hormone and I should call back on Monday. They said the lining of my womb was very thin for a pregnancy, but it would be at only 2 weeks anyway wouldn't it???? I went to buy a clearblue test and did it immediately when I got home and I am so pleased IT IS POSITIVE!!!!
Anyway, in the hospital they said there is a small chance it could be an ectopic pregnancy but I doubt this as I would be in severe pain wouldn't I?? I really really hope to God this is not the case.
SO, the spotting has stopped but I have still got this dull ache in my back, to the left, like mild period pain. I have heard that a lot of women bleed through their pregnancy and have cramps, but my bleeding was only spotting and was brown. Am I worrying over nothing here????? I also have a weird pain from my thigh right down to my shin, this could be just coincidental.
I have a 3 year old son and had nothing like this with that pregnancy. Please could anyone help me? Any words of wisdom or advice, anyone had this problem?
Thanks, Becs xxxxx

i would go to my GP and get them to do a test.
my mum had bleedin through 1 of her pregnancies, even when she was 8 months gone. even the tests were negative, her GP asked her to test at eight months gone and it was still negative its probaby nothing to worry about sweetie but get the test done by u'r GP aswell and see what he/she says.
GOOD LUCK SWEETHEART!!!  😘

Hi Kel,
thanks for your reply. I will do that. I need to phone back the hospital on Monday and see what they say, until then I have the weekend to try and get by without worrying. Thanks again, love Becs xxxxx 😘

Hi Becs
It could just be that it is implant bleeding.  I havent had it before but I have heard of mums who have.  I think that as long as your Clearblue is coming up pos then all should be ok, but as Kel says it is worth going to your gp to get checked.
Sometimes your local pharmacy can offer a pg test too at a reduced rate.  Maybe your one does too??
Hope all is okay today.
😘

whatever you do dont panic hon. bleeding is perfectly normal with some people. i bled for two weeks i didnt know i was pregnant i just thought i got my period. if i had known i woul have been as worried as you sound but everything turned out perfectly fine. the best thing you can do is stay calm and go and get yourself checked over. if your only two weeks then its gonna be difficult for doctors to see anything so dont be alarmed if they cant.it doesnt nessecarily mean something is wrong x

hi everyone, thanks for replying, it really eased my mind. The good news is, today the spotting is only very slight, I haven't got any pain and am feeling a lot better. I didn't sleep to well with worry but I know that can't be good for either of us so am planning to relax this weekend. I will let you know what happens at the hospital on Monday. Thanks for your support, I'm so glad I found this site. xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 😍

I had spotting at five weeks, I went to my local EPU for a scan but George was so early on he didn't have a heartbeat at that point, I went back at seven weeks and everything was fine.
They put down my spotting to a bruise in my womb that could have been from implantation that seemed show up on the scan at five weeks.
I had gone to A&E at a hospital nearer to us and they were concerned I was having an ectopic so don't worry too much as they got it wrong with me.
Fingers crossed for you hun xx    😘

Wow, thanks candgsmum! I am so pleased to hear everything went well for you, I am feeling a lot more positive. Your experience is very similar to mine so I am really feeling much better. Thank you for replying xxxxxxxxxx 😘

i wouldnt worry hunny i had brown spotting with all 3 of mine and was told its a show i thought you could only have a show at late stages of pregnancy but the midwife said you can have them at the start aswell its diffrent with every pregnancy and person 🙂

i had bleeding at 7 weeks with my son and it was lots more than spotting but i had a scan and there he was fine and everything and now he is 13 months old
dont worry hunni cos worrying can ,ake it worse and the back ache i had my normal monthly period pains all the way through all of my pregnancies and so did my mum so try not to worry about that to hun
good luck babe
xxxx

Hi chez and bunnygirl, thank you so much for your replies. I feel a lot better today, I'm glad other people have had similar problems as me and have come through it fine! I am really happy for you guys!
The spotting has gone, I have got a bit of tummy ache (trapped wind) as I am quite constipated (sorry). I want to get to monday now, and know for sure that everything is ok!
Thanks again, love Becs xxxxx 😘  😀

well i hope everything goes ur way on monday hunni and that all is fine
keep us posted ok babe
take care
xxx

Thanks very much, fingers crossed for me pleeease.
I will let you know on Monday. Take care too xxxxx 🙂

let u know how u get on tomoz

Hi there, glad to hear you are feeling more confident and less stressed about the situation.  🙂
Keep us posted on how you are on Monday. I know when I went to my local EPU there were so many women there in the same situation and the nurses and sonographers were fantastic support too.
xx
good luck for tomorrow hunnie, i'll be thinking bout u. got everything crossed for u!  😘

Hi, thank you all so much for your replies and support. At en emotional time it is great to know I have lovely women behind me, helping me along the way. The spotting has still stopped, no pain (apart from trapped wind) which is really weird as I don't usually suffer from it. Thanks for thinking of me and keeping everything crossed. 😘
Twins would be lovely (sammie), but if God blesses us with just the one healthy baby in this pregnancy we will be soo happy. Although twins do run in my partner's family  😜
I really do think it was just implantation spotting as it hasn't made another appearance since and I am only around 2 weeks, so it's on time.
Thanks again and I'll keep you posted. Take care everyone  😍

Hi everyone, I just called the hospital. They said for 4 weeks pregnancy the hoemone level should be between 500-2000 or sumthin like that. I know that there is no way I am 4 weeks, I am 2 weeks at the max, it's very early stages! She said on the phone 'now you did this test a month ago', where the hell she got that from I don't know. I did the test one week before I had the spotting and I told her that!
So she said my count was 197 and that means with either i am very early or that this pregnancy will not get off the ground and will come away. I know that I am very early so I am not too worried.
I am going back for more blood taken tomorrow to be checked to see ig the hormone level is rising. I am soo annoyed at how insensitive and abrupt the midwife was on the ohone, like me feelings didn't matter.
Anyway, fingers crossed for me. I have no pain and no spotting so I am putting it down to implantation spotting and hormone level is coz im still early.
Let you know tomorra, gota shoot off to work.  😘  Bye for now xxxxx

let us knw how u'r doing.

Here is my journal of the last 2 week and half of my spotting. Spotting Journal
Week one
17th Oct – 01:30	5w+4
First signs of spotting, this was a mixed of pink almost watered down blood and light brown blood. I proceeded to call the out of hours Maternity unit at James Cook Hospital, were I was booked in for the 1st Nov. For 8 week scan.
18th Oct – all day  5w+5
Wiped after urinating with a mixed of very little show to a moderate brown blood when wiping only.
19th Oct – 13:00	5w+6
Discovered beige discharge in underwear.  No show of brown blood.
20th Oct 	6w
More showing of brown blood still have tender breasts only in the morning, feeling somewhat nauseas or is it anxiety? Call JC Maternity unit again and they advised me that there is nothing they can do until 1/11/10
21st Oct	6w+1
Not an awful lot of spotting today thinking that this maybe the end of it!
22nd Oct – 17:30	6w+2
Away from home on my own and discovered lots of red spotting what can only be described as mucus, which is thin and stingy. Panicked, after a dozen wipes no more signs. Thinking I’m miscarrying. No more showing apart from a bit of dark brown blood.
23rd Oct – all day 6w+3
Bed rest all day today only got up for toilet and sandwich drank lots and lots of water. Had the on off dark brown spotting today. Feel like I am going to start my period.
24th Oct – all day 6w+4
A bit more dark brown spotting and again feel like I’m going to start my period. Felt nauseas this afternoon but only for an hour.  This morning woke up with tender breasts.  Evening 21:30 showing a bit of red blood had a little bit of mild abdomen pain about an hour before show!!
Week Two
25th Oct - 	6w+5
Morning- has slight brown bleeding today, then this afternoon a larger amount only when I wiped. About 8pm this evening I’ve been having intermittent cramps not too severe but enough to notice ever single one of them. Bedtime and they started to get a little bit more uncomfortable, woke up at 5am by intense cramping.
26th Oct - 	6w+6
Cont.. ..5am went to the toilet and discovered bright red blood and a small clot in the bowl (about the size of a 5 pence piece).  Off to A&E. Eventually through to the maternity unit, had an internal inspection, where midwife informed me my cervix is still closed. But can’t determined where or why I’m bleeding like I am, I was given painkillers and sent on my way. Bed resting but still having cramps. Today is a day I wouldn’t wish for my worst enemy and hopefully want experience again. Cramps have got progressively worse. Cramps are every 3-8 mins, a lot of bleeding, that bad that I cry when they happen.
27th Oct. – 7w
Cramps have eased off slightly, having milder cramps today. Produced an unidentifiable thick blood clot with some grey matter (tissue) in it. Called maternity assessment unit and they advised me to take it down for examination. They confirmed what I already knew. Miscarrying, after a distressing week there is some conclusion to my worrying few days, about not know exactly what was going on.
28th Oct - miscarrying
Cramps aren’t as often, even though they did get a little worse this evening.  Continuing to bleed heavy and passing smaller blood clots.  Expecting this to be like this for the next week or so.
I HOPE THAT MY EXPERIENCE CAN HELP OTHERS (even though I am aware that its not like this for everyone, and those have a successful pregnancy).
When I’m healthy and strong enough  we will start again.  ***POSITIVITY***

Really sorry to hear that Miniminogue. I can't imagine the heartache you've gone through, wish you all the best for when you start trying again.
I am a little worried at the moment because me & my bf have been trying for a little while (but probably not as long as most). Yesterday I woke up feeling sick & was feeling pretty rough all day headache, sick etc. Then in the evening I started to experience some very light pinkish blood only when I wiped. It was the same this morning up till about 11am & then it started to get a bit heavier & redder. I constantly feel sick but don't have any pain. I did a test about 3 weeks ago because I hadn't had a period since 24th June but it was negative. I'm really worried to test again because I know how disappointed my bf will be if I have to tell him it was negative & we've missed another chance, cos now I'm on my period. Do people think this sounds like normal spotting or am I just "coming on" and we'll just have to keep trying. Thanks
